d:
A timeless melody that beautifully captures the emotions of love! Tu Pyar Tu Preet Tu from the 1971 film Paraya Dhan features the charming pairing of Rakesh Roshan and Hema Malini. Soulfully sung by Kishore Kumar and Lata Mangeshkar, this evergreen romantic duet brings together two legendary voices in a beautiful musical composition.\
Tu Pyar Tu Preet | Paraya Dhan (1971) | Rakesh Roshan, Hema Malini | Kishore-Lata Hit Hidni Songs
Song: Tu Pyar Tu Preet Tu
Movie: Paraya Dhan (1971)
Star Cast: Rakesh Roshan, Hema Malini, Balraj Sahni
Singers: Kishore Kumar, Lata Mangeshkar
